implemented: Holm family-wise adjustment can consume an immutable ordered set of registered trial IDs and returns a hash of the complete family.
Unrun/failed candidates with missing p-values remain in the family and receive p=1 for adjustment; unknown, duplicate, or invalid trials are rejected.
A test with 100 registered trials confirms the best candidate is adjusted across all 100, not only the 2 with reported p-values.
